title: For each IPL season, identify the top three batsmen with the highest total
question: For each IPL season, identify the top three batsmen with the highest total runs scored and the top three bowlers with the most wickets taken, excluding ‘run out’, ‘hit wicket’, and ‘retired hurt’ dismissals. In the event of ties in runs or wickets, break the tie using the smaller player ID. Then output these six players in matched positions—batsman 1 with bowler 1, batsman 2 with bowler 2, and batsman 3 with bowler 3—in ascending order of the season ID, along with each player’s total runs or wickets.

prediction.sql:
WITH bat AS (
  SELECT m.season_id, b.striker AS player_id, SUM(s.runs_scored) AS runs
  FROM batsman_scored s
  JOIN ball_by_ball b ON s.match_id=b.match_id AND s.over_id=b.over_id AND s.ball_id=b.ball_id AND s.innings_no=b.innings_no
  JOIN match m ON b.match_id=m.match_id
  GROUP BY m.season_id, b.striker
),
bat_rank AS (
  SELECT season_id, player_id, runs,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY season_id ORDER BY runs DESC, player_id ASC) rn
  FROM bat
),
wk AS (
  SELECT m.season_id, b.bowler AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS wickets
  FROM wicket_taken w
  JOIN ball_by_ball b ON w.match_id=b.match_id AND w.over_id=b.over_id AND w.ball_id=b.ball_id AND w.innings_no=b.innings_no
  JOIN match m ON b.match_id=m.match_id
  WHERE w.kind_out NOT IN ('run out','hit wicket','retired hurt')
  GROUP BY m.season_id, b.bowler
),
wk_rank AS (
  SELECT season_id, player_id, wickets,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY season_id ORDER BY wickets DESC, player_id ASC) rn
  FROM wk
)
SELECT br.season_id,
       br.player_id AS batsman_id, br.runs,
       wr.player_id AS bowler_id, wr.wickets
FROM bat_rank br
JOIN wk_rank wr ON br.season_id=wr.season_id AND br.rn=wr.rn
WHERE br.rn<=3
ORDER BY br.season_id ASC, br.rn ASC

bat_ranked AS (
  SELECT season_id, player_id, runs,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY season_id ORDER BY runs DESC, player_id ASC) AS rn
  FROM bat
),
bowl AS (
  SELECT m.season_id, b.bowler AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS wickets
  FROM wicket_taken w
  JOIN ball_by_ball b ON w.match_id=b.match_id AND w.over_id=b.over_id AND w.ball_id=b.ball_id AND w.innings_no=b.innings_no
  JOIN match m ON b.match_id=m.match_id
  WHERE w.kind_out NOT IN ('run out','hit wicket','retired hurt')
  GROUP BY m.season_id, b.bowler
),
bowl_ranked AS (
  SELECT season_id, player_id, wickets,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY season_id ORDER BY wickets DESC, player_id ASC) AS rn
  FROM bowl
)
SELECT br.season_id,
  br.player_id AS batsman_id, br.runs,
  bw.player_id AS bowler_id, bw.wickets
FROM bat_ranked br
JOIN bowl_ranked bw ON br.season_id=bw.season_id AND br.rn=bw.rn
WHERE br.rn<=3
ORDER BY br.season_id ASC, br.rn ASC

  SELECT m.season_id, b.striker AS player_id, SUM(s.runs_scored) AS runs
  FROM batsman_scored s
  JOIN ball_by_ball b ON s.match_id=b.match_id AND s.over_id=b.over_id AND s.ball_id=b.ball_id AND s.innings_no=b.innings_no
  JOIN match m ON b.match_id=m.match_id
  GROUP BY m.season_id, b.striker
),
bat_rank AS (
  SELECT season_id, player_id, runs,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY season_id ORDER BY runs DESC, player_id ASC) rn
  FROM bat
),
wk AS (
  SELECT m.season_id, b.bowler AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS wickets
  FROM wicket_taken w
  JOIN ball_by_ball b ON w.match_id=b.match_id AND w.over_id=b.over_id AND w.ball_id=b.ball_id AND w.innings_no=b.innings_no
  JOIN match m ON b.match_id=m.match_id
  WHERE w.kind_out NOT IN ('run out','hit wicket','retired hurt')
  GROUP BY m.season_id, b.bowler
),
wk_rank AS (
  SELECT season_id, player_id, wickets,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY season_id ORDER BY wickets DESC, player_id ASC) rn
  FROM wk
)
SELECT br.season_id,
       br.player_id AS batsman_id, br.runs,
       wr.player_id AS bowler_id, wr.wickets
FROM bat_rank br
JOIN wk_rank wr ON br.season_id=wr.season_id AND br.rn=wr.rn
WHERE br.rn<=3
ORDER BY br.season_id ASC, br.rn ASC
